metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: emery
plugins.description: Skills for the Emery workflow: `/emery:init` scaffolds a project, `/emery:plan` authors the change-level plan, `/emery:execute` confirms Gate 1 and drives the drained execute loop, the per-slice breakouts (`/emery:refine`, `/emery:build`, `/emery:merge`, `/emery:drop`) drive one slice at a time, and `/emery:finalize` closes the change.
